title: Tốc độ & bẫy
goal: Hai nhóm câu khó nhất là hàm ý câu nói và nhìn bảng biểu — cả hai gần như không bao giờ rơi vào câu đầu (1.7% và 0.4%), nên biết trước là chúng chờ ở câu 2 và câu 3.

drills.title: Câu hỏi hàm ý
drills.instruction: Nghe đoạn rồi chọn đáp án đúng.

items.question: What does the man imply when he says, "the company's certainly had other priorities"?
items.transcript:
W: Have you reviewed the data from the workplace survey? You really should. It looks like most staff feel positive about the direction that the company is going in. But almost 40 percent feel like their individual contributions aren't being recognized.
M: Well, the company's certainly had other priorities. I wonder how the management team's going to respond.
W: I've suggested many times that they give out awards every quarter for exceptional performance. Maybe now they'll finally start doing it.
53. What does the woman want the man to look at?
54. What does the man imply when he says, "The company's certainly had other priorities"?
55. What has the woman suggested in the past?
options: He is not responsible for some results.
Some decisions led to a successful outcome.
items.explanation: Khi người phụ nữ chỉ ra nhân viên cảm thấy không được ghi nhận, người đàn ông nói 'The company's certainly had other priorities' (Công ty chắc chắn đã có những ưu tiên khác), ngụ ý thừa nhận rằng lời chỉ trích đó là đúng vì công ty đã lơ là việc ghi nhận đóng góp.
items.label: implication

items.question: What does the speaker mean when he says, "We have a lot of work to do"?
items.transcript:
M-Au: As head of the product design team, I have the sales results from the last quarter, and they're disappointing. It's clear that consumers are no longer interested in the types of toys and games we've been producing. My guess is that people are getting tired of noisy, blinking electronics. We have a lot of work to do. There's a new trend toward outdoor toys and games, where people can be physically active. I've already come up with some prototypes of new games. I brought a few of them, and now I'll show you how they work.
86. What did the speaker recently receive?
87. What does the speaker mean when he says, "We have a lot of work to do"?
88. What will the speaker do next?
options: A job opening will be posted soon.
items.explanation: Vì kết quả kinh doanh đáng thất vọng và người tiêu dùng không còn hứng thú với đồ chơi cũ, người nói bảo "Chúng ta có rất nhiều việc phải làm" để ám chỉ rằng họ phải thay đổi thiết kế sản phẩm sang xu hướng mới (đồ chơi ngoài trời).
items.label: implication

items.question: What does the woman imply when she says, "my company has asked me to relocate to Spain"?
items.transcript:
M: Hello, you've reached the customer service line for Quality Internet Service. How can I help you?
W: I'm Mona Shannak, and my account number's PK62H5. I'd like to close my account on June thirtieth.
M: Oh, have you been experiencing issues with the service?
W: Actually, my company has asked me to relocate to Spain.
M: That's exciting! I'll take care of your request for you then.
W: Thank you-I appreciate that.
M: When I'm done updating your records, would you be willing to stay on the phone line to take a survey about your experience as a customer?
W: Certainly.
59. What type of business does the man work for?
60. What does the woman imply when she says, "my company has asked me to relocate to Spain"?
61. What does the man ask the woman to do?
options: She was surprised by a job transfer.
She has no complaints about a service.
She would like paperwork sent to a different address.
items.explanation: Khi nhân viên hỗ trợ lo lắng hỏi xem cô ấy có gặp vấn đề gì với dịch vụ không (khiến cô ấy phải đóng tài khoản), cô ấy giải thích lý do chuyển nhà là vì công việc. Việc này ngụ ý rằng dịch vụ vẫn tốt, cô hủy dịch vụ chỉ vì lý do cá nhân.
items.label: implication

items.question: Why does the speaker say, "I only use the highest-quality materials in my work"?
items.transcript:
Hi, Ms. Alvarez. I'm calling to let you know I e-mailed the price estimate you requested for the replacement of your metal roof. I'm sure you've received lower estimates from other businesses. But you should know, I only use the highest-quality materials in my work. Please check out the reviews on my Web site if you have any doubts. I know you hoped that I'd complete the project before you go away on your vacation, but I'm completely booked for the month of March. I could start at the beginning of April, though. I look forward to hearing back from you soon.
92. What industry does the speaker most likely work in?
93. Why does the speaker say, "I only use the highest-quality materials in my work"?
94. What does the speaker say could happen in April?
items.explanation: Người nói rào trước rằng khách hàng có thể nhận được báo giá thấp hơn ('received lower estimates') từ nơi khác, nhưng ngay sau đó khẳng định mình chỉ dùng vật liệu chất lượng cao nhất. Mục đích là để biện minh cho mức giá cao của mình.
items.label: implication

items.question: Why does the man say, "we do have money available in the budget"?
items.transcript:
W: Did you see that the results of last month's employee survey have been compiled? All the staff feedback is available.
M: Yes, and I just finished reviewing the comments.
W: You know, I noticed one recurring complaint. The size of the break room is too small. Perhaps we could enlarge the break room by having the wall taken down between it and the meeting room next door.
M: Well, we do have money available in the budget.
W: Then could you reach out to your contact at the construction company?
M: I can't do it this afternoon, since I need to see a dentist, but I will definitely make the call.
56. What did the company do last month?
57. Why does the man say, "we do have money available in the budget"?
58. What does the man say he has to do this afternoon?
options: To agree with a proposed renovation
To recommend an increase in advertising
items.explanation: Khi người phụ nữ đề xuất phá bỏ bức tường để mở rộng phòng nghỉ, người đàn ông đáp: 'Well, we do have money available in the budget.' (Chà, chúng ta có sẵn tiền trong ngân sách). Anh ấy đồng ý với đề xuất cải tạo vì có kinh phí (To agree with a proposed renovation).
items.label: implication

items.question: What does the speaker imply when she says, "we have such a large group today"?
items.transcript:
Welcome to the culinary tour of downtown Springfield. Today, you'll taste a variety of local foods. Normally I'd start by taking you inside Zelda's Bakery to try one of their famous corn muffins, but we have such a large group today. Instead, we're going to head directly to the open-air market. There you'll find a wide selection of the homemade breads, jams, and pastries that we're noted for. After that, we'll head to the original Springfield cornmill, which is still in use today. And remember to keep your tour ticket. It's good for one free entry at the local museum.
77. What is the focus of a tour?
78. What does the speaker imply when she says, "we have such a large group today"?
79. What will a ticket allow the listeners to do?
options: She is happy about the popularity of a tour.
She will need to use a microphone.
An additional tour guide is needed.
A shop is not big enough for everyone.
items.explanation: Người hướng dẫn nói: 'Normally I'd start by taking you inside Zelda's Bakery... but we have such a large group today. Instead, we're going to head directly to the open-air market.' (Thông thường tôi sẽ đưa bạn vào Tiệm bánh Zelda... nhưng hôm nay nhóm chúng ta rất đông. Thay vào đó, chúng ta sẽ đi thẳng ra chợ ngoài trời). Ý nói cửa hàng quá nhỏ không chứa đủ mọi người (A shop is not big enough for everyone).
items.label: implication

items.question: Why does the woman say, "I have many options for you to consider"?
items.transcript:
W: Good morning, Mr. Murray. I'm here to help you start planning the opening of your newest art gallery.
M: Great! As you know, this will be our third location. So I think I might like to try a different kind of approach this time.
W: I understand. I have many options for you to consider.
M: Glad to hear it.
W: Let me grab the catering menu and the book of flower selections from my van. It's parked just outside.
53. What is the conversation mainly about?
54. Why does the woman say, "I have many options for you to consider"?
55. What will the woman do next?
options: To praise the work her team did
items.explanation: Sau khi khách hàng (người đàn ông) nói muốn thử một cách tiếp cận khác cho lần này, cô ấy nói câu này để trấn an anh ấy rằng mình đã chuẩn bị nhiều phương án phù hợp.
items.label: implication

items.question: What does the speaker mean when he says, "Management will be watching closely"?
items.transcript:
M-Au: Oh good. I'm glad to see everyone is here early, as requested. We have an unusually busy night ahead of us-due to the addition of six large group reservations. We'll set up for those first in the overflow room. Tables will need to come out of storage. I'll unlock the door after this meeting. But before you start your shift, make sure to try tonight's specials. They're in their usual spot under the heat lamps. Be sure you promote the truffles dish in particular. We'd like to see if this could be a permanent menu item. Management will be watching closely. Its price point is high, but it really is delicious.
89. Why does the speaker call employees in early?
90. What should be retrieved from storage?
91. What does the speaker mean when he says, "Management will be watching closely"?
options: A decision about an item will be made soon.
A client may not renew a contract.
items.explanation:
Trước câu nói đó, anh ấy đề cập đến việc muốn xem xét liệu món nấm cục có thể trở thành món thường xuyên trong thực đơn hay không ("see if this could be a permanent menu item"). Ban quản lý theo dõi doanh số của món này để ra quyết định đó.
ĐOẠN HỘI THOẠI 8 (
items.label: implication

items.question: Why does the speaker say, "we have a full supply of those in stock"?
items.transcript:
Hi. It's Sarai. I'm calling about the new wallpaper patterns that your team submitted. We all really like the geometric prints. I'm almost certain that all of those will be approved for production in several different color schemes. And the wallpaper patterns for children's rooms are all so imaginative. You have some truly creative people on your design team. However, the animal-themed prints you sent-the thing is, we have a full supply of those in stock. Call me back so we can discuss it.
86. What does the speaker's company sell?
87. Why does the speaker praise the listener's team?
88. Why does the speaker say, "we have a full supply of those in stock"?
options: To report that inventory has been completed
To offer to share some supplies with another store
To explain that some designs are not needed
To confirm that a customer's order can be filled
items.explanation:
Tuy nhiên người nói phàn nàn: 'the animal-themed prints you sent-the thing is, we have a full supply of those in stock.' (các mẫu họa tiết động vật... vấn đề là chúng tôi đã có sẵn đủ số lượng). Ý nói không cần thiết kế này nữa (To explain that some designs are not needed).
Đoạn độc thoại (
items.label: implication

items.question: Why does the speaker say, "A bus will be departing for that destination in fifteen minutes"?
items.transcript: Attention, passengers. All trains to Midway Station are delayed for track repairs. They expect to complete the repair within the hour. A bus will be departing for that destination in fifteen minutes. Also, a reminder that the station café opens at eight A.M., and there are food kiosks on platform one.
options: To explain an extended wait time
To recommend changing the travel date
To inform customers about a new destination
items.explanation: Vì tàu hỏa (train) đang bị hoãn, người nói cung cấp thông tin về một chuyến xe buýt (bus) sẽ đến cùng địa điểm đó trong 15 phút nữa. Đây là cách gợi ý phương tiện thay thế cho những hành khách không muốn chờ đợi tàu sửa xong.
items.label: implication

items.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "Great Fitness orders from us all the time"?
items.transcript:
W: We just got a rush order from Great Fitness. They need T-shirts with their business name and logo printed on the front-1,000, to be exact.
M: That's an unusually large order.
W: We're definitely going to need some employees to work overtime on it.
M: Hmm, I don't know how easy that's going to be. It's the summer, and a lot of employees were hoping to take time off.
W: Well, OK. We could offer them an additional day off next month.
M: I'm still worried about the three other orders we need to complete this week.
W: I know, but Great Fitness orders from us all the time.
59. What type of product are the speakers discussing?
60. What does the woman propose offering to some employees?
61. What does the woman mean when she says, "Great Fitness orders from us all the time"?
options: Great Fitness's order is the priority.
Great Fitness has complained about a delivery.
items.explanation:
Khi nói 'Great Fitness orders from us all the time' (Great Fitness lúc nào cũng đặt hàng từ chúng ta), người phụ nữ ngụ ý đây là khách hàng trung thành, đơn hàng của họ là ưu tiên (Great Fitness's order is the priority).
Đoạn hội thoại (
items.label: implication

items.question: Why does the speaker say, "those have been popular lately"?
items.transcript:
OK, team, let's discuss our first-quarter sales figures. Unfortunately, retail sales of our smartwatches and other products have continued to fall. Our president has proposed expanding the product line to include a virtual reality headset. And those have been popular lately. You can expect a lot more information at a future meeting. Next on the agenda, Raya will be demonstrating the new software we'll be using to track consumer purchasing trends.
92. Which department does the speaker most likely work in?
93. Why does the speaker say, "those have been popular lately"?
94. What will the listeners do next?
items.explanation: Người nói đề cập việc chủ tịch đề xuất thêm 'virtual reality headset' (tai nghe thực tế ảo) vào dòng sản phẩm, sau đó củng cố thêm rằng chúng 'have been popular lately' (gần đây rất phổ biến), thể hiện sự đồng tình với đề xuất đó.
items.label: implication

items.question: Look at the graphic. Which stage of market research will Sarai talk about?
items.transcript:
In today's meeting, we'll discuss where we are in our software development process for Universal Banking. In-depth user research will help us create a better online banking application. Sarai will start by telling us about her research into Universal Banking's target customers. What features do they need in a banking app, and how comfortable are they with technology? But before Sarai begins her presentation, let me remind you that as summer begins next week, so do summer hours. You'll be able to stop working at 2:00 o'clock on Friday afternoons, so we'll be moving our regular meeting to Friday mornings.
98. What industry is the mobile app intended for?
99. Look at the graphic. Which stage of market research will Sarai talk about?
100. What will begin next Friday?
items.explanation: Nghiên cứu về: 'Sarai will start by telling us about her research into Universal Banking's target customers.' (Nghiên cứu về khách hàng mục tiêu). Xác định khách hàng mục tiêu thường là Giai đoạn 1 (Stage 1).
items.label: graphic

items.question: Look at the graphic. Which dollar amount will the man change?
items.transcript:
W: Marco, you'll be restocking the cleaning products this morning, right? While you're doing that, could you also put the updated sale-price labels on the hand soap dispensers? They're on the shelf right above the laundry detergent.
M: No problem-that shouldn't take long. What else can I help with?

items.question: Look at the graphic. Where will a table be set up?
items.transcript:
M: Magali, were you able to reserve the performing arts center for the piano concert?
W: Yes. I booked their main auditorium for that day. They're sending me the contract.
M: Thanks for doing that.
W: No problem. Hopefully, it'll be as successful as last year.
M: We sold 2,000 tickets last year, but we had three celebrity performers. I'm worried we won't sell as many tickets this year.
W: Well, Xinyu Gu is a very popular pianist. And she's staying after the concert to sign autographs. Which reminds me, where should we set up the table for that?

65. What does the man thank the woman for doing?
66. What does the man say he is worried about?
67. Look at the graphic. Where will a table be set up?
items.explanation: Người đàn ông quyết định 'Let's set it up next to the café' (Hãy thiết lập nó cạnh quán cà phê).
items.label: graphic

items.question: Look at the graphic. How much will the woman pay for the flower arrangement?

Người phụ nữ mua kiểu cắm hoa 'Harmony arrangement'. Dựa vào đồ họa, giá của loại này có thể là $7
5.

items.question: Look at the graphic. Which workshop will be offered on Fridays starting in March?
items.transcript:
M-Cn: Hello, everyone! We're happy to announce that the February continuing education workshops here at the community center were very successful. Thank you for working so hard to make sure they ran smoothly. Every workshop was completely full. In fact, we had to create a waiting list for the Monday night workshop. Beginning in March, we'll offer that same workshop on Fridays. Now, many participants complained about the lack of vending machines in the building. Bianca will be contacting vending services next week to ask about pricing.
98. Where does the speaker work?
99. Look at the graphic. Which workshop will be offered on Fridays starting in March?
100. What will Bianca do next week?

Beginning in March, we'll offer that same workshop on Fridays" (chúng tôi đã lập danh sách chờ cho hội thảo tối thứ Hai, và từ tháng 3 sẽ dời hội thảo đó sang thứ Sáu). Bằng cách nhìn vào bảng lịch trình (graphic), lớp học được lên lịch vào "Monday night" chính là đáp án cần chọn.

items.question: Look at the graphic. Where will the upcoming harvest be stored?

drills.title: Nghe trọn bộ — Part 4
drills.instruction: Nghe hết đoạn rồi trả lời liên tiếp 3 câu, đúng nhịp đề thi thật.

items.question: According to the speaker, what is special about the Reston Office Tower?
items.transcript: The downtown Reston Office Tower is completed. The most extraordinary feature of the building is its beautiful garden, located in the lobby. We interviewed the CEO of Barnum Financial Services about its new offices. He said he and his team are excited to move in in January. A recording of the full interview is available on our Web site.
options: It exhibits work from local artists.
items.explanation: Người nói miêu tả: "The most extraordinary feature of the building is its beautiful garden, located in the lobby" (Đặc điểm phi thường nhất của tòa nhà là khu vườn xinh đẹp của nó, nằm ở sảnh chờ). special = extraordinary.

items.question: Look at the graphic. Which floors will be occupied in January?
items.transcript: The downtown Reston Office Tower is completed. The most extraordinary feature of the building is its beautiful garden, located in the lobby. We interviewed the CEO of Barnum Financial Services about its new offices. He said he and his team are excited to move in in January. A recording of the full interview is available on our Web site.
items.explanation: Đoạn âm thanh cho biết Giám đốc điều hành của Dịch vụ Tài chính Barnum đã xác nhận rằng nhóm của họ "rất hào hứng khi chuyển đến vào tháng Giêng." Câu hỏi hỏi những tầng nào sẽ có người sử dụng vào tháng Giêng. Mặc dù hình ảnh không được cung cấp, nhưng trong một câu hỏi TOEIC Phần 4 điển hình có hình ảnh, hình ảnh sẽ hiển thị trực quan công ty nào chiếm giữ những tầng nào. Vì lựa chọn (C) là câu trả lời đúng, hình ảnh đi kèm sẽ cho thấy Dịch vụ Tài chính Barnum được chỉ định cho các tầng 11-14. Do đó, đây là những tầng sẽ có người sử dụng vào tháng Giêng.

drills.title: Truy ngược câu sinh ra đáp án
drills.instruction: Cho sẵn đáp án đúng. Chọn câu trong bài nghe đã sinh ra đáp án đó. Đây là bài tập trực diện cho bẫy paraphrase.

items.question:
Câu hỏi: What did the man's client request?
Đáp án đúng: A shortened timeline
options: The project schedule. They asked us to provide the prototype design to them three weeks earlier than originally planned.
That's so nice of you! I'll go with the White Cloud Coffee. I like a little milk in mine.
Well. Then today's cup is my treat. Which one would you like?
Apparently, he's planning to retire next month.
items.explanation:
Khách hàng yêu cầu nộp thiết kế mẫu "three weeks earlier than originally planned" (sớm hơn 3 tuần so với dự kiến ban đầu).

Đáp án gần như không bao giờ dùng lại nguyên từ trong bài — luôn là cách diễn đạt lại.

items.question:
Câu hỏi: Why does the man recommend reading an e-mail?
Đáp án đúng: To consider a business proposal
options: This morning I got an e-mail from Pelicon, a local producer of beauty products. They're interested in purchasing lanolin from us to use in their new line of all-natural makeup.
But our contract with the business we currently supply lanolin to has almost expired-there's no guarantee it will be renewed. I think you should at least read Pelicon's proposal.
Sure. Can you forward me the e-mail?

I'm not sure about that. We're a fairly small farm, and we already sell lanolin to another local business. I'm worried that we don't produce enough lanolin to meet the demand of another client. I don't want to expand and take on more wool production.
items.explanation:
Người đàn ông khuyên: 'I think you should at least read Pelicon's proposal' (Tôi nghĩ ít nhất bạn nên đọc đề xuất của Pelicon), để xem xét một đề xuất kinh doanh.

Đáp án gần như không bao giờ dùng lại nguyên từ trong bài — luôn là cách diễn đạt lại.

items.question:
Câu hỏi: What does the man suggest doing?
Đáp án đúng: Attending a workshop
options: Well, Archester Library is running a workshop next month on digitization practices. I think we should attend.
Hiroki, good news! We've received the grant money we requested to digitize our rare book collection.
Excellent! I'm glad we'll finally be able to expand access to our collections. Right now, only local residents can see those books.
Great idea. Let's register right away.
items.explanation:
Người đàn ông gợi ý: 'Archester Library is running a workshop next month... I think we should attend.' (Tham dự hội thảo).

Đáp án gần như không bao giờ dùng lại nguyên từ trong bài — luôn là cách diễn đạt lại.

items.question:
Câu hỏi: What did the company do last month?
Đáp án đúng: It conducted an employee survey.
options: Well, we do have money available in the budget.
Then could you reach out to your contact at the construction company?
Did you see that the results of last month's employee survey have been compiled? All the staff feedback is available.
Yes, and I just finished reviewing the comments.
items.explanation:
Người phụ nữ nhắc đến: 'the results of last month's employee survey have been compiled' (kết quả cuộc khảo sát nhân viên tháng trước đã được tổng hợp). Công ty đã thực hiện khảo sát nhân viên (It conducted an employee survey).

Đáp án gần như không bao giờ dùng lại nguyên từ trong bài — luôn là cách diễn đạt lại.

items.question:

Đáp án đúng: For an inventory count
options: As an added benefit, we offer extended warranties on all vehicles we service.
Our factory-trained specialists will keep your vehicle running in top condition.
We specialize in all makes and models of automobiles.
Please note that Select Repair Service will be closing on Friday, June 30, so we can complete our quarterly inventory of supplies.
items.explanation:
Người nói thông báo lịch đóng cửa vào thứ Sáu với lý do: "so we can complete our quarterly inventory of supplies" (để chúng tôi có thể hoàn thành việc kiểm kê vật tư hàng quý).

Đáp án gần như không bao giờ dùng lại nguyên từ trong bài — luôn là cách diễn đạt lại.

Đáp án đúng: The age of a building
options: Your house was built a long time ago and has settled over the years.

I'm calling because we've run into an issue with the front window replacements.

Vấn đề xảy ra là do "Your house was built a long time ago" (Ngôi nhà của ông được xây dựng từ rất lâu rồi) dẫn đến "frame alignment issues" (vấn đề về căn chỉnh khung). Yếu tố "xây từ lâu" chính là tuổi đời (age) của tòa nhà.

True. Maybe we can make up for the cost of the flights by economizing on hotels. Let's look into that.
